events.verdict: Sengun (HOU) does not maintain verticality and initiates contact with Lillard (MIL) that affects his driving shot attempt.
Lillard (MIL) places his hands on Thompson's (HOU) back and the contact as he releases to pursue the rebound is marginal.
Green (MIL) briefly places his hands on Green (HOU) on the perimeter, but the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Lopez (MIL) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball and the ensuing contact with Sengun (HOU) is incidental.
Lillard (MIL) goes to, but not through Thompson's (HOU) space as he releases away during the drive.
Thompson (HOU) legally contests Lillard's (MIL) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) cleanly blocks the shot attempt prior to when the ball reaches its apex.
Antetokounmpo's (MIL) left foot is out of bounds when he receives the pass from Lopez (MIL).
Green (HOU) briefly wraps an arm around Antetokounmpo's (MIL) leg, but the contact does not affect his FOM.
Green (HOU) avoids making contact with Lillard (MIL) during his driving shot attempt.
Jackson Jr. (MIL) commits a take foul on Sengun (HOU).
Sengun (HOU) and Antetokounmpo (MIL) engage and immediately disengage during the throw-in.
Sengun (HOU) remains in bounds after regaining possession of the ball.
Smith Jr. (HOU) mishandles the pass and the contact by Antetokounmpo (MIL) when the ball is loose is incidental.
